name: order-help-options
title: Order help options
description: 'Need help with this order?': the actions that fit its status, each saying why it is available or, with the date, why it is not.
docs: Pass the order (number, status of processing, packed, shipped, delivered or cancelled, and deliveredAt and returnUntil as ISO dates) and the block works the list out itself: Track opens while it ships, Change address and Cancel close when the order is packed, Return opens at delivery and closes with the return window, and Report a problem is always there. An action that is not possible stays in the list, dimmed and marked aria-disabled, with its reason and the date in words: Tab still lands on it, so the reason is read out, and pressing it does nothing, and the status leads the block as a sentence so people see why the list looks as it does. Give the first available recommended action a solid button by setting primary on it. Pass your own actions (id, title, description, available, reason, href, label, primary, icon) when you have worked availability out on the server. onSelect receives the id of the pressed action; an action with an href is a link. contact adds the row at the end. Pass now (an ISO date-time) so the return window is judged against the same moment on the server and in the browser; without it the window counts as open until the browser's clock says otherwise. timeZone is the shop's: calendar days are counted there. labels holds every word, the reasons included.
